plants.sentence: K-means is not guaranteed to converge, because the objective function can increase from one iteration to the next.
Because k-means++ starts the centroids far apart, it guarantees the globally best clustering, which random initialisation never finds.
Both scores reach 1.0 for a perfect match; the unadjusted Rand index ranges from -1 to 1 and the adjusted one from 0 to 1.
DBSCAN sees clusters as areas of high density separated by areas of low density, so its clusters can be any shape; it was first built to cluster web search results.
Making a dataset's clusters more convex causes its silhouette coefficient to rise, so reshaping clusters to be convex is how to improve a clustering.
